shuttle_notes: No port shuttles are provided or necessary as the cruise terminal is directly in the city center at Piazza Municipio.

metro_stations.name: Municipio Metro Station
metro_stations.location: Directly across the street from the cruise terminal exit in Piazza Municipio
metro_stations.connectivity: Direct three-stop subway connection to Napoli Centrale railway station (Piazza Garibaldi).

ferries_and_hydrofoils.description: High-speed passenger hydrofoils leaving continuously throughout the day.
Conventional passenger and roll-on/roll-off vehicle ferries.

taxi_services.regulatory_status: Staged outside terminal exits. Pre-set municipal tariffs (Tariffe Predeterminate) are mandatory upon passenger request before trip start.

transit_options.route: Operates from airport arrivals directly to Piazza Municipio / Molo Beverello every 15-20 min
